reference: There are not many customers in the salon, only one.
sk: V salóne nie je veľa zákazníkov, iba jedna.
cz: V salonu není moc zákazníků, jen jedna.
acceptable: There are not many {customers|clients} in the salon, {only|just} one.
In the salon there are not many {customers|clients}, {only|just} one.

mistakes.text: There are not much customers in the salon, only one.
There is not many customers in the salon, only one.
There are not many customer in the salon, only one.
There are no many customers in the salon, only one.
There are not {a lot of|lots of} customers in the salon, only one.
In the salon are not many customers, only one.

source_issues: Native 'iba jedna/jen jedna' is feminine (one female customer); English 'only one' fits.
